content: useThreads only activates when the runtime advertises compatible REST thread endpoints (GET /threads, PATCH /threads/:id, POST /threads/subscribe) — provided by CopilotKit Intelligence Platform (cloud or self-hosted Helm: k8s+Postgres+Redis+OIDC). Self-managed runners (InMemory/SqliteAgentRunner/custom) persist and replay history but do NOT provide the useThreads list/mutation/realtime contract. Self-hosting Intelligence requires Kubernetes/Postgres/Redis — far too heavy for a local-first single-process app. Railyin: useThreads is unusable; own thread-index endpoint required.
